home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Start running your shop from here: finish what is left to set up and reach the screens you use most in one click.

setup.title: Get your shop ready to sell
setup.subtitle: Complete the steps in order. Each button takes you to the screen where the step is done; come back here when you finish.
setup.allDone: All steps are done. Your shop looks ready to sell.
setup.error: The setup steps could not be loaded right now. Please try again shortly.

storeName.title: Give your shop a name
storeName.description: The shop name is used in the admin and wherever your customers see your shop.

currency.title: Choose your currency
currency.description: Product prices are entered and shown in this currency; Turkish lira (TRY) for Turkey.

region.title: Add the country you sell to
region.description: Sets which country you sell to and how taxes are calculated; the admin calls this screen "Regions".

location.title: Add your shipping address
location.description: The warehouse or shop your parcels leave from; stock is kept per address.

shipping.title: Set up a shipping option
shipping.description: Customers pick one of these when they order (e.g. "Standard shipping"); you add them on your shipping address's page.

product.title: Publish your first product
product.description: Only products marked "Published" appear in your shop; drafts are not shown to customers.

addProduct.title: Add product
addProduct.description: Create a new product with its name, photos, price and stock.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: See incoming orders and follow their payment and shipping.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Store details, shipping, SEO and other settings.

numbers.title: Your products

published.label: Published
published.hint: Products your customers see in your shop

draft.label: Draft
draft.hint: Not published yet, visible in the admin only

numbers.empty: You have not added any products yet. Start by adding your first one.
numbers.error: Product numbers could not be loaded right now. Please try again shortly.

billingProfile.title: Billing details
billingProfile.empty: The customer has not entered billing details yet.
billingProfile.error: Billing details could not be loaded.
billingProfile.maskedHint: The ID number is masked for security.

errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again.

seo.template_invalid: The template has a tag this field does not support, or broken braces.
seo.path_taken: Another record already uses this URL.

errors.users_only: Only signed-in admin users can do this.

errors.busy: The record is being updated by another action; try again in a few seconds.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Features you can turn on or off for your store. Turning one off disables its screens and actions.
features.empty: There are no features to turn on or off yet. New features will show up here.

seo.title: SEO
seo.subtitle: General settings that shape how your store appears in search engines.

host.label: Primary domain
host.hint: Used in the permanent addresses of product and category pages. Left empty, the platform subdomain is used.

templates.title: Title and description templates
templates.tooLong: May be cut in a Google result

robots.title: Crawlers
robots.label: robots.txt
robots.hint: The {sitemap_url} tag is replaced with the sitemap address when published.

samples.kısa_açıklama: A durable product for everyday use

test_sample.label: Sample feature
test_sample.description: A sample feature that appears in tests only.

test_platform_sample.label: Platform sample feature
test_platform_sample.description: A platform-managed sample feature that appears in tests only.

attributes.title: Product attributes
attributes.noTemplates: No attribute templates yet. Create one under Settings > Product attributes.

changeTemplate.title: Change the template?
changeTemplate.description: The product's current attribute values will be removed when you save.

attributeTemplates.title: Product attributes
attributeTemplates.subtitle: Define the attributes products take with templates; each product picks one template.
attributeTemplates.empty: No templates yet. Create the first one for your products.
attributeTemplates.name: Name
attributeTemplates.handleHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; cannot be changed later.
attributeTemplates.noAttributes: This template has no attributes yet.

removeValues.title: Remove attribute values?
removeValues.description: Products' values for the attributes you removed will be deleted too.

attributeTemplates.publicWarning: Attribute values are public on product pages and in the Store API. Do not keep internal data such as costs or supplier codes here.

asyncJobs.title: Jobs
asyncJobs.subtitle: Long tasks such as exports run in the background; follow their progress and results here. Result files are kept for 7 days.
asyncJobs.truncated: Only the first {{rows}} rows were taken.

errors.interrupted: The job stopped midway (the server may have restarted); run it again.
errors.not_started: The job never started; run it again.

catalog.title: Catalog details
catalog.subtitle: The product's identity for search engines, Google Shopping and product feeds.

primaryCategory.label: Primary category
primaryCategory.hint: Breadcrumbs, structured data and the "back to category" link come from this category.
primaryCategory.noCategories: Add a category to the product first.

successor.label: Successor product
successor.hint: Once the product is no longer sold, its URL points to this product. Pick a true equivalent only.

variants.title: Variant codes
variants.hint: The GTIN is read from the variant's EAN, UPC or barcode field. The MPN is the manufacturer part number; with the brand it identifies a product that has no GTIN.
